title: Diamond Elite Card: Maximizing Your 5% Rewards on Every Transaction
summary: This document explains how to maximize 5.0% rewards with the Diamond Elite Card by routing eligible high-value purchases and consolidating recurring bills (subscriptions, utilities, insurance). It also covers redemption timing (redeem once you meet 5), keeping the account in good standing via autopay/timely payments, avoiding non-earning transactions (fees/cash equivalents), monthly merchant-spend reviews, and contacting support if rewards post incorrectly.
